ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent interest in Old Sock makes this a natural next listen; I would choose it today for its relaxed blues feel.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues guitar direction fits my interest in Memphis and People, Hell & Angels, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Let Me Get By; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its rootsy blues and soul sound appeals to me, though I am only choosing one album this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Croz; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Reflective songwriting fits the mood of You Should Be So Lucky, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Heaven & Earth; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in blues and roots songwriting right now than progressive rock.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental music is not what I want for this listening session.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country direction connects with my interest in Blown Away, but today I am leaning toward blues.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rattle That Lock; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive guitar playing appeals to me, but I do not feel a strong enough pull to choose it now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Plain Spoken; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its understated roots songwriting sounds compatible with my recent listening, but I would leave it for later.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Led Zeppelin; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title does not identify the release clearly enough for me to choose it during this brief visit.
